notes: Vocative *all ye lands*: *ye* stands before the noun, so it is the noun's under rule 36 rather than the imperative's; article unrepresented (no *the* written), margin *all the earth* read and set aside (rule 38).
הָרִיעוּ → *Make a joyful noise* is a light verb plus complement (rule 44), headed on *noise*; *joyful* is the ASV's specifier and the competing head.
